instruction: I need to edit the master slide layout but I'm in normal view. Please switch to Master Slide view so I can modify the slide templates.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(2)

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to switch to Master Slide view in LibreOffice Impress. Evaluator checks accessibility tree for Master view indicators (menu items or panels containing 'Master').

llm_judge_reasons: IMPROVED - The metric function now implements multiple verification checks as previously suggested, including 'Close Master View' menu item, window titles, panels, toolbars, status bars, and labels.
STRONG INDICATOR - The 'Close Master View' menu item check (line 28-32) is the most reliable indicator, as it only exists when already IN Master view, not in normal view.
GOOD COVERAGE - Multiple fallback checks provide robustness in case the primary indicator is not found in the accessibility tree.

MINOR LOGIC ISSUE - The function returns 1.0 if ANY indicator is found (master_view_indicators > 0), which means weak indicators (generic labels/panels containing 'Master') could cause false positives. Better approach: prioritize 'Close Master View' check and only use other checks as fallbacks.
SEMANTIC CORRECTNESS - The logic correctly distinguishes between 'Master view available as menu option' vs 'Currently IN Master view' through the 'Close Master View' check.
ADEQUATE VERIFICATION - The evaluator can semantically verify the instruction requirement (switch to Master Slide view), though with minor risk of false positives from weak indicators.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: OPTIONAL - Improve scoring logic: Prioritize strong indicators (Close Master View menu item, window title with 'Master View') over weak indicators (generic labels/panels). Consider weighted scoring or returning 1.0 only for strong indicators.

OPTIONAL - Add stricter label/panel checks: Instead of just checking if 'Master' is in the name, verify specific text patterns like 'Master Slide Editing' or 'Master Page Panel' to reduce false positives.
OPTIONAL - Consider requiring multiple indicators: For higher confidence, require at least 2 indicators to be present before returning 1.0.
